sections.heading: This Week in AI
sections.body: Nine massive stories just dropped — reshaping how we build, ship, and secure AI systems.
bulletPoints: OpenAI acquires PromptFoo for agent security
DeepSeek V4 delayed amid the model wars

sections.heading: Claude Gets Code Review
sections.body: Anthropic shipped Code Review — a multi-agent system that scans every PR for logical bugs, not just style nits. It's been running on nearly every Anthropic PR for months.

sections.heading: Multi-Agent Review Pipeline
sections.body: Multiple agents analyze code in parallel from different angles. A final agent aggregates findings, removes duplicates, and ranks by severity.

codeSnippet.code:
# .github/workflows/claude-review.yml
name: Claude Code Review
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: anthropic/code-review@v1
        with:
          severity: [red, yellow, purple]
          depth: auto  # scales with PR size
          # Large PRs get deeper analysis
          # Small PRs get lighter pass

sections.heading: Copilot Goes Autonomous
sections.body: Microsoft's Copilot Cowork — built on Anthropic's Claude — turns requests into structured plans and executes across the entire M365 stack. It's not chatting anymore. It's doing.

sections.heading: Gemma 4 Incoming
sections.body: Google's next open-weight model was spotted in a GitHub PR before being scrubbed. Gemma 4 could bring frontier-level performance to local hardware.
bulletPoints: Leaked via Google bot account on GitHub

sections.heading: DeepSeek V4 on Hold
sections.body: DeepSeek V4 was expected in early March — possibly timed to China's Two Sessions. Leaks showed 1M context windows and dynamic sparse attention. But OpenAI's latest drop may have forced a strategic delay.

sections.heading: OpenAI Buys PromptFoo
sections.body: OpenAI acquired PromptFoo — the open-source red-teaming tool used by 25% of Fortune 500 companies. The 11-person startup raised just $23M before the deal. It's staying open source.

sections.heading: Agent Security Stack
sections.body: PromptFoo's tech powers automated red-teaming, security evaluation, and compliance monitoring inside OpenAI Frontier.

codeSnippet.code:
# Test agent security with PromptFoo
npx promptfoo eval \
  --providers openai:gpt-5.2 \
  --plugins hijacking,harmful \
  --output vuln-report.json

# Used by 25% of Fortune 500

sections.heading: Gemini CLI Minimal Mode
sections.body: Google's Gemini CLI now supports minimalist mode — double-tap Tab to strip the interface to just a prompt box. Less verbose tool calls, smoother experience. Making CLI AI accessible to everyone.

sections.heading: OpenClaw Levels Up
sections.body: The open-source AI agent platform shipped two rapid-fire releases packed with major upgrades.
bulletPoints: New backup system for safer deploys
GPT 5.4 and Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite support

sections.heading: Grok Gets Creative
sections.body: Elon Musk teased Grok Imagine 1.5 after users praised its consistent style across full image extensions. xAI's image generation upgrade could drop any day.

quote.text: As engineers develop with Claude Code, friction to creating features decreases — and demand for code review skyrockets.
quote.author: Cat Wu

sections.heading: What's Next
sections.body: Nvidia's NemoClaw is coming — an open-source agent platform with GPU-native capabilities. Between Copilot Cowork, Code Review, and PromptFoo inside Frontier — the AI stack just got a whole lot more autonomous.
